Profile
Aptiv PLC is a supplier of automotive technology and components. It is organized in Jersey and is a resident of Schaffhausen, Switzerland, for tax purposes. The company operates 139 major manufacturing facilities and 11 major technical centers and has a presence in 50 countries. In 2025, its products were used in 18 of the 20 top-selling vehicle models in the United States. In 2025, 36% of the company's revenues were derived in the United States, 32% were derived in Europe, the Middle East and Africa, and 29% were derived in Asia-Pacific. The company traces its roots to Delphi Automotive, which was a subsidiary of General Motors until May 1999. Wikipedia
